# docs documentation

Read when finding documentation in this directory.

| Document | Type | Status | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Deterministic checks](checks.md) | runbook | - | `docreview facts` and `docreview catalog` check documentation with code only. They never read a credential or contact a model. Use them in CI, in a pre-commit hook and before asking for a model review. This page explains how to run them and every rule they apply. |
| [Project declaration](declaration.md) | reference | - | A project tells the engine about its documents in one file, `docs-review.toml`, at the repository root. This page defines that file, the default document types and the two authority modes. The declaration and the [report](output.md) are the only contract between the engine and a project. |
| [Report and exit codes](output.md) | reference | - | Every `facts` and `review` run writes one JSON object to stdout, or to `--out` in `owned` mode. This page defines its fields and the exit codes. Field names are stable: new fields may be added, none renamed or removed without a new `policy_version`. |
| [Model-assisted review](review.md) | runbook | - | `docreview review` joins the [deterministic checks](checks.md) with narrow questions for a decision model. It returns a located `pass`, `revise` or `review` for each page. It does not edit documents, dispatch agents or approve changes. This page explains how to prepare a review, run it safely and read the result. |
